Either it is covered by a single vertical tromino (leaving a 3×(n-1) rectangle: a(n-1) ways), or none of its three cells is covered vertically, so each is the left end of a horizontal tromino, and together they fill columns 1–3 exactly (leaving a 3×(n-3) rectangle: a(n-3) ways).
